critical_negative_test.method: Use current canonical_pulse_id(sequence,scheduled_at) at 300-second cadence with current persisted Bloom filter.
critical_negative_test.root_cause: A Bloom false positive on a genuinely new canonical pulse is fail-closed as duplicate. Because duplicate handling does not advance sequence or next_due_at, all later automatic pulses regenerate the same canonical ID and remain permanently suppressed.
critical_negative_test.impact: Deterministic long-run heartbeat liveness deadlock after about 2 days 9 hours on current canonical sequence; unsuitable for persistent autonomous runtime.
critical_negative_test.existing_suite_gap: Current 26 tests cover old-ID replay but do not test long-run canonical unique-pulse false-positive liveness.
